title: 第十章 聚餐第十一章 钳制
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
【陈月：我们在校门口】
【陈洛：1】
陈洛回到宿舍，刚穿好衣服，便收到妹妹的消息。
他随手回复收到，转身离开宿舍，准备叫上李佳乐出发。
刚到隔壁，抬起手，门便自动打开。
李佳乐穿着潮牌服饰，脖子挂着银色吊坠，还带了一块看上去就很名贵的手表。
“...”
看着他这乱搭一通的服饰，陈洛张了张嘴，欲言又止。
“怎么说，有没有搞头？”
李佳乐倒是浑然不自知，还兴奋地张开双臂展示。
“...你开心就好。”
陈洛上下打量他一番，欲言又止，只拍了拍肩膀，便带头朝楼下走去。
二人一路赶到校门。
陈洛远远便看到陈月，斜挎着黑色小包，在校门口旁边站得笔直。
不知道的，还以为是在罚站。
相较之下。
一身浅绿长裙，搭配白纱短外套的苏小红，看上去则有活力得多。
“这边！”
她经由陈月提醒，远远便带着笑容，蹦蹦跳跳地朝二人招手。
或许是被苏小红那堪称模板化的，青春活力女大学生的形象震住。

陈洛明显听到李佳乐的步伐，变得有些僵硬慌乱。
“义父...义父！！！”
在陈月和苏小红看不到的视角里，李佳乐声音颤抖，连连击打陈洛的后腰，以此发泄心中的兴奋。
“有病就他妈去治，别发癫。”
陈洛一边笑着抬手回应苏小红，一边咬牙回应。
来到二女面前。
【神经反应】
【是否复制词条？】
【是】
“你好，我是陈月的哥哥，陈洛。”
“这是我同学，李佳乐。”
开启复制倒计时后，陈洛率先介绍。
先前还在发癫的李佳乐，此刻倒像个新兵蛋子，只僵硬地挥手问好，屁都没敢放一个。
“你们好。”
苏小红带着笑脸，分别朝二人打招呼。
陈月则以近乎微不可察的弧度，快速朝李佳乐点了下脑袋，便悄悄挪动脚步，靠向陈洛身侧。
“咱们走吧，拖太晚又得排队。”
【黄街】原属于澜海市的老城区，近些年改造成商业街。
每逢周末或是节假日，不光大学生会组团闲逛聚餐。
上班族，游客，都会扎堆往里挤。

要是再晚点，四人想要吃饭，少说得排一两个小时的队。
于是。
content_en:
[Chen Yue: We are at the school gate]
[Chen Luo: 1]
Chen Luo returned to the dormitory. As soon as he got dressed, he received a message from his sister.
He replied casually that he had received it, turned around and left the dormitory, preparing to call Li Jiale to set off.
As soon as you reach the next door, you raise your hand and the door opens automatically.
Li Jiale was wearing trendy clothes, with a silver pendant hanging around his neck, and a very expensive-looking watch.
"..."
Looking at his random clothes, Chen Luo opened his mouth but stopped talking.
"What do you mean, have you done anything?"
Li Jiale didn't know it at all and even opened his arms to show it excitedly.
"...As long as you're happy."
Chen Luo looked him up and down, hesitated to speak, only patted his shoulder and took the lead to walk downstairs.
The two of them rushed to the school gate.
Chen Luo saw Chen Yue from a distance, standing straight next to the school gate with a small black bag slung across his body.
Those who didn’t know, thought it was a penalty stand.
In comparison.
Su Xiaohong, who is wearing a light green dress and a white gauze short jacket, looks much more energetic.
"This way!"
After being reminded by Chen Yue, she jumped up and down with a smile on her face and waved to the two of them from afar.
Perhaps she was shocked by Su Xiaohong's stereotyped image of a young and energetic female college student.
Chen Luo obviously heard Li Jiale's steps and became a little stiff and panicked.
"Father...Father!!!"
From a perspective that Chen Yue and Su Xiaohong couldn't see, Li Jiale's voice trembled and he hit Chen Luo's lower back repeatedly to vent his excitement.
"If you're sick, just go get it and don't go crazy."
Chen Luo smiled and raised his hand to respond to Su Xiaohong, while gritting his teeth in response.
Come to the two women.
【Nervous reaction】
[Do you want to copy the entry? 】
【Yes】
"Hello, I am Chen Yue's brother, Chen Luo."
"This is my classmate, Li Jiale."
After starting the copy countdown, Chen Luo took the lead in introducing it.
Li Jiale, who was still going crazy before, now looked like a new recruit. He only waved stiffly to say hello and didn't even dare to fart.
"Hello."
Su Xiaohong greeted the two of them respectively with a smile on her face.
Chen Yue quickly nodded towards Li Jiale with an almost imperceptible arc, then quietly moved her steps and leaned towards Chen Luo.
"Let's go, it's too late and we have to queue up."
[Huang Street] was originally part of the old town of Lanhai City, but has been transformed into a commercial street in recent years.
Every weekend or holiday, not only college students will form groups to hang out and have dinner.
Office workers and tourists will all crowd in.
If it were any later, the four of us would have to wait in line for an hour or two if we wanted to eat.
